test_title: PYST 31: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

We are the creative force of our life, and through our own decisions rather than our conditions, if we carefully learn to do certain things, we can ______ those goals.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2**' i.e. **'Accomplish'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct word to fill in the blank in this context is** "accomplish".**
 
• **Accomplish:** This verb means to achieve or complete something successfully.
 
• This** fits well** in the context of achieving goals, which is the subject of the sentence.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is:* 'We are the creative force of our life, and through our own decisions rather than our conditions, if we carefully learn to do certain things, we can **accomplish** those goals.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Expel: **This verb means to force out or eject, often used in the context of a person being removed from a place or organization. It doesn't make sense in the context of achieving goals.
 
• **Torment: **This verb means to cause great physical or mental suffering. It doesn't fit in this context because it contrasts with the positive tone of the sentence about achieving goals.
 
• **Reverberate: **This verb means to be repeated as an echo, a sound, or a consequence. It doesn't fit in this context as it doesn't align with the concept of achieving goals.
